name: claudetto
description: Lists the claudetto plugin and its optional code-graph, browser, docs, sessions, and lab plugins.

plugins.name: claudetto
plugins.description: Adds a lean output style, a status line command, the `setup` skill, and Jev answers for `AskUserQuestion` when a key is set. Adds hooks that deny a `Bash` command that only prints a file, check plan files for claims with no source, and check Markdown line breaks.

plugins.name: claudetto-codegraph
plugins.description: Gives Claude the code graph of a project from the CodeGraph CLI `codegraph`. The skill `codegraph` shows the commands, and `/claudetto:setup` offers `codegraph install` when this add-on is on.

plugins.name: claudetto-browser
plugins.description: Drives a browser with `agent-browser`, or with CloakBrowser on sites with bot detection when the user chooses it. With the `cloakbrowser` backend, answers each `WebSearch` call that the permission rules allow with a search in CloakBrowser, and needs its binary.

plugins.name: claudetto-docs
plugins.description: Gets current library and API docs with the Context7 CLI `ctx7`. Works with no key.

plugins.name: claudetto-sessions
plugins.description: Reads the setup of Claude Code and past transcripts with two scripts: an audit of settings, plugins, hooks, and the bytes that load at session start, and a replay of a hook on past tool calls.

plugins.name: claudetto-lab
plugins.description: Tools for plugin authors. Runs Claude Code in a sandbox, captures and sizes the requests, writes the JSON Schema of `settings.json`, and compares the eval scores of two plugin folders.
